description:
v1.0 | 195 gates | 4 ticks
https://github.com/byggmesterPRO/pareto-circuits

Compares two 32-bit numbers.

Use this to compare two numbers in a creation, such as checking an entered code against a stored one for a combination lock, or switching a lamp on once a sensor reading passes a set level.

Put the first number into the first group of inputs and the second number into the second group, with the lowest value input first in each group. Exactly one output is on: the first for smaller, the second for equal, the third for larger. Both numbers are unsigned.

Inputs (yellow gates, first row, lowest bit first): a = x 0-31, b = x 32-63.
Outputs (green gates): a < b = x 0, a = b = x 1, a > b = x 2.

Profile: fast, the build with the fewest ticks for this size.
How it works: One wide gate per term: gates take any number of inputs, so no stages are needed.
Checked on about a million inputs in a simulator. Gates include the input gates; ticks count the input gate too.

Other sizes, the generator and the full explanation:
https://github.com/byggmesterPRO/pareto-circuits/tree/main/circuits/comparator
